```{r}
# ============================================================
# Recurrent fusion circos plot
# ============================================================

# ==== Load libraries ====
library(circlize)
library(data.table)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Set cohort = "Tumor" or "PDO"
# ============================================================
cohort <- "PDO" 

# ============================================================
# Input / output settings
# ============================================================
if (cohort == "Tumor") {
  fusion_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/Tumor/functional_fusions_expression_only_Tumor.csv"
  recurrent_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/Tumor/repeated_fusions_across_samples.tsv"
  outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/Tumor"
  out_prefix <- "Functional_Fusion_Combined_Tumor_Circos"
} else if (cohort == "PDO") {
  fusion_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/IPM/functional_fusions_expression_only_PDO.csv"
  recurrent_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/IPM/repeated_fusions_across_samples.tsv"
  outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/IPM"
  out_prefix <- "Functional_Fusion_Combined_PDO_Circos"
} else {
  stop("Invalid cohort. Use 'Tumor' or 'PDO'.")
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Load functional fusion data
# ============================================================
fusion_data <- fread(fusion_file)

# ============================================================
# Load recurrent fusions across samples
# This file is a TSV and the fusion name column is 'fusions'
# unique() removes repeated entries coming from different samples
# ============================================================
events_to_label_df <- read.delim(
  recurrent_file,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

events_to_label <- unique(events_to_label_df$fusions)

# show rows in fusion_data that match recurrent fusions
matched_fusions <- fusion_data[fusions %in% events_to_label]
print(paste("Number of matching recurrent fusions in fusion_data:", nrow(matched_fusions)))
if (nrow(matched_fusions) > 0) {
  print(head(matched_fusions))
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Keep valid chromosomes only
# ============================================================
valid_chroms <- paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X"))
fusion_data <- fusion_data[fusion_data$chrA %in% valid_chroms & fusion_data$chrB %in% valid_chroms]

# ============================================================
# Keep only fusions with expression status of interest
# ============================================================
fusion_data <- fusion_data[exp %in% c("up-regulation", "down-regulation")]

# ============================================================
# Remove rows with missing breakpoint coordinates
# ============================================================
fusion_data <- fusion_data[!is.na(StartA) & !is.na(StartB)]
fusion_data$EndA <- fusion_data$StartA
fusion_data$EndB <- fusion_data$StartB
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Generate colors for recurrent fusions
# ============================================================
n_events <- length(events_to_label)

if (n_events <= 8) {
  label_colors <- brewer.pal(max(3, n_events), "Dark2")[1:n_events]
} else if (n_events <= 12) {
  label_colors <- brewer.pal(n_events, "Set3")
} else {
  label_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(n_events)
}

names(label_colors) <- events_to_label

# ============================================================
# Color mapping for expression status
# ============================================================
exp_colors <- c(
  "up-regulation"   = "#E64B35",
  "down-regulation" = "#4DBBD5"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Create links table for circos
# These are the links that will be drawn inside the circos plot
# ============================================================
links <- data.frame(
  chr1 = fusion_data$chrA,
  start1 = fusion_data$StartA,
  end1 = fusion_data$EndA,
  chr2 = fusion_data$chrB,
  start2 = fusion_data$StartB,
  end2 = fusion_data$EndB,
  exp = fusion_data$exp,
  fusion_name = fusion_data$fusions,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Create highlight bars for recurrent fusions
# Use unique breakpoint pairs only
# Both gene A and gene B ends are highlighted
# ============================================================

bar_width <- 10e3  # 10 Kb window for visibility

highlight_bars_list <- list()

for (event in events_to_label) {
  
  # Keep only rows for this fusion
  event_data <- links %>%
    filter(fusion_name == event)
  
  # Remove repeated same breakpoint pairs across samples
  event_data_unique <- event_data %>%
    distinct(fusion_name, chr1, start1, end1, chr2, start2, end2, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  if (nrow(event_data_unique) > 0) {
    
    # Gene A side bars
    bars_A <- data.frame(
      chr    = event_data_unique$chr1,
      start  = pmax(1, event_data_unique$start1 - bar_width / 2),
      end    = event_data_unique$end1 + bar_width / 2,
      fusion = event,
      color  = unname(label_colors[event]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    # Gene B side bars
    bars_B <- data.frame(
      chr    = event_data_unique$chr2,
      start  = pmax(1, event_data_unique$start2 - bar_width / 2),
      end    = event_data_unique$end2 + bar_width / 2,
      fusion = event,
      color  = unname(label_colors[event]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    # Combine A and B bars for this fusion
    highlight_bars_list[[event]] <- bind_rows(bars_A, bars_B)
  }
}

# Combine all events
highlight_bars <- bind_rows(highlight_bars_list)

# Optional: remove exact duplicate bars if still present
highlight_bars <- highlight_bars %>%
  distinct(chr, start, end, fusion, color, .keep_all = TRUE)

print(paste("Number of recurrent fusion highlight bars created:", nrow(highlight_bars)))
if (nrow(highlight_bars) > 0) {
  print(head(highlight_bars))
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Circos plotting function
# ============================================================
plot_fusion_circos <- function() {
  circos.clear()
  
  circos.par(
    "track.height" = 0.25,
    cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
    gap.degree = 2
  )
  
  # Initialize human hg38 ideogram
  circos.initializeWithIdeogram(
    species = "hg38",
    chromosome.index = valid_chroms
  )
  
  # Outer highlight bars for recurrent fusions
  if (nrow(highlight_bars) > 0) {
    circos.track(
      ylim = c(0, 1),
      track.height = 0.05,
      bg.border = NA,
      track.index = get.current.track.index() + 1,
      panel.fun = function(x, y) {
        chr <- CELL_META$sector.index
        bars_in_chr <- highlight_bars[highlight_bars$chr == chr, ]
        
        if (nrow(bars_in_chr) > 0) {
          for (i in 1:nrow(bars_in_chr)) {
            circos.rect(
              xleft = bars_in_chr$start[i],
              xright = bars_in_chr$end[i],
              ybottom = 0,
              ytop = 1,
              col = bars_in_chr$color[i],
              border = bars_in_chr$color[i],
              lwd = 1.5
            )
          }
        }
      }
    )
  }
  
  # Spacer track
  circos.track(ylim = c(0, 1), track.height = 0.03, bg.border = NA)
  
  # Draw fusion links inside the ideogram
  for (exp_type in unique(links$exp)) {
    subset_links <- links[links$exp == exp_type, ]
    
    if (nrow(subset_links) == 0) next
    
    circos.genomicLink(
      region1 = subset_links[, c("chr1", "start1", "end1")],
      region2 = subset_links[, c("chr2", "start2", "end2")],
      col = adjustcolor(exp_colors[exp_type], alpha.f = 0.75),
      rou = 0.75,
      lwd = 0.8
    )
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Full plot = circos + legend
# ============================================================
draw_full_plot <- function() {
  layout(matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 1), widths = c(3, 2))
  
  # Circos panel
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
  plot_fusion_circos()
  
  # Legend panel
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
  plot.new()
  
  legend(
    "top",
    legend = names(exp_colors),
    col = exp_colors,
    pch = 15,
    pt.cex = 2,
    cex = 1.2,
    title = "Fusion Expression",
    bty = "n"
  )
  
  legend(
    "center",
    legend = events_to_label,
    col = label_colors,
    pch = 15,
    pt.cex = 2,
    cex = 1,
    title = "Highlighted Recurrent Fusions",
    bty = "n"
  )
}

draw_full_plot()
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Output directory
# ============================================================
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# Save as PNG
# ============================================================
png(
  file.path(outdir, paste0(out_prefix, ".png")),
  width = 2400,
  height = 1600,
  res = 300
)
draw_full_plot()
dev.off()

# ============================================================
# Save as PDF
# ============================================================
pdf(
  file.path(outdir, paste0(out_prefix, ".pdf")),
  width = 14,
  height = 8
)
draw_full_plot()
dev.off()
```
